newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's KGHM 1996 net tumbles to PLN 147.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Poland's KGHM 1996 net tumbles to PLN 147.2 mln.

text.p: The net profit of Poland's KGHM copper concern tumbled to 147.2 million zlotys last year from a 481.9 million net profit in 1995, the company said in its financial report published in the Rzeczpospolita daily.
It said its sales eased to 3.59 billion zlotys in 1996 from 3.72 billion a year before while its operational costs rose to 3.15 billion zlotys from 2.74 billion zlotys in 1995.

The annual report's auditors -- BDO Binder Sp. z.o.o and Deloitte & Touche Audit Services Sp. z.o.o said large provisions KGHM made in 1996 towards future expenses and potential losses depleted its net profit.
KGHM's report said it allotted a total of 273.95 million zlotys for provisions in 1996 against 5.7 million zlotys in 1995. KGHM officials declined comment on the results.
